easyPrerequisites: You have a land card in hand or on top of your library.
description:
Cast Library of Leng by paying {1}.
When Library of Leng enters, Rook Turret triggers, causing you to draw a card and then discard a land card.
The discarded card is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Surly Badgersaur triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Rook Turret triggers, causing you to draw a card and then discard a land card.
Repeat from step 3.
